rules: NP-ICP v2 is used as implemented: abep_icp::v2::IcpModelV2::evaluate on cases built from this record. No model change, no new model version, no edited frozen record.
Physics / assessment separation (AS-01..AS-05): the model emits raw I_e,cap only; every bound, ratio, M_n and closure state is formed in abep-assess (module closure_icp), never in abep-icp.
Fail closed: an unregistered input stays unregistered and the model names it; nothing is defaulted; a withheld output is reported with its reason codes, never replaced by a bound or an analog.
The ICP chemistry registry (data/chemistry/icp/) is read, not changed, in this lane (see not_changed.registry).

The conservation bounds (M-B) are NECESSARY-CONDITION bounds: labels CONSERVATION_BOUND / NOT_A_PERFORMANCE_PREDICTION. The published analog (M-C) is ANALOG_ESTIMATE_NOT_A_MODEL_RESULT; it is a risk indicator and never changes a closure state, never triggers a DCR and never enters a gate.

M_n is reported in the governed HC-05 form only through abep_assess::neutralization (hc05 / neutralization_quantities). The brief's I_e,cap / I_beam form is reported as the necessary condition I_e,cap >= I_beam,LB, labelled, never as an acceptance criterion.

No number in this record is fitted to a result; every value is a DBF-1 item, a registered repository record, a recorded lawful source read (source_reads) or a declared engineering assumption with evidence class and uncertainty.

M-A.name: NP-ICP v2 evaluation
M-A.rule: For each mode in {AIR_PRIMARY, XE_CONTINGENCY, EM-N2}, each composition member, each P_abs, each p_ICP and each V_bias of the grid: build the case from RI-01..RI-08 and the DBF-1 config, call IcpModelV2::evaluate (abep_icp::constants::NUMERICS). Record per mode: status counts, the union of reason codes with counts, flags, verify items on path, I_e_cap_A per point (value or withheld status) and the envelope (min / max over CONVERGED points; withheld when none).

items.B1: I_beam,LB(T) = T sqrt(e / (2 m_i,max V_d,max)): singly charged ions, all accelerated through at most V_d,max (plume potential >= cathode-common reference), no divergence, neutral-gas thrust neglected; heaviest ion of the mode (AIR: O2+, 2 x 15.99977 u; XE: Xe+, 131.299 u; electron mass neglected, which lowers the bound); multiply charged ions and divergence only raise I_beam per thrust
items.B2: I_e,req,LB(T) = I_beam,LB(T): CPL-HON-03 (cathode-common topology: I_e,emit = I_d) and I_d >= I_beam
items.B3: I_e,cap <= I_e,cap,UB(P_abs) = e P_abs / E_iz,min for the NP-ICP v2 model class: I_e,cap <= I_production (the model's PRODUCTION limit) and every ionization event costs at least the lowest ionization energy present from P_abs (Maxwellian, no secondary emission, no photo-ionization in the model). E_iz,min: AIR 9.2642 eV (NO present; SB-NO unresolved) and 12.0697 eV (O2; no NO); XE 12.1298437 eV
items.B4: P_abs,min,cons(T) = I_e,req,LB(T) E_iz,min / e; eta_p,min,cons = P_abs,min,cons / P_net,max (500 W)
items.B5: G-REUSE isotropic pressure information p <= 4 (mdot / m) k T_g / (vbar (2 pi R^2)), vbar = (8 k T_g / (pi m))^1/2, at mdot in {1.43e-9 (DBF1-BD-01 worst delivered), 4.796e-8 (A4 12 mN), 2.082e-7 (A4 25 mN)} kg/s for O (15.99977 u), N2 (2 x 14.00728 u) and Xe (131.299 u) [information for the RI-06 grid only]

M-C.name: published-analog absorbed power per extracted ampere (Xe only)
M-C.rule: P_abs,analog(T) = I_e,req,LB(T) x epsilon_ext with epsilon_ext in {230, 450} eV per extracted ion (SR-05 GK2008 sec. 4.5, 20-cm rf ion thruster, absorbed-power basis: 450 eV/ion unconfined, 230 eV/ion with 10 G induced AC field, 'in good agreement with the data about this size of rf thruster'); eta_p,req,analog = P_abs,analog / P_net,max; shortfall factor = eta_p,req,analog / eta_p,ref. Not DBF-1-specific (different geometry, pressure and extraction); AIR: no registered analog -> NOT_EVALUATED.

M-D.name: neutralization margin status
M-D.rule: HC-05 through abep_assess::neutralization::hc05 (capacity basis MODEL, I_e,cap from M-A at the reference member, I_d,max,H1 unregistered, no VALIDATED_BENCH cell, no margin rule) and neutralization_quantities; the I_e,cap / I_beam form of the A9.38 brief is reported as the necessary condition I_e,cap >= I_beam,LB with label NECESSARY_CONDITION_NOT_A_GATE. GNG-ICP-01 echoed from rvm_a9_v1 (criteria PENDING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE).

closure_state_rule.condition: for a flight mode and T in {12, 25} mN: I_e,cap,UB(P_abs = P_net,max = 500 W, eta_p = 1) < I_e,req,LB (B3 < B2): the frozen DBF1-RF-02 envelope cannot supply the necessary current even by conservation
I_e,cap CONVERGED, model VERIFIED, point inside a VALIDATED_BENCH cell (or measured), I_d,max,H1 registered and HC-05 MET at the RFP thrust points
every NP-ICP input registered, I_e,cap CONVERGED in both flight modes at the reference point with I_e,cap >= I_e,req,LB at 12 and 25 mN; only verification / validation / HC-05 evidence pending
otherwise; the residual reason codes per mode are the named blockers

closure_state_rule.note: M-C never changes the state. FUNDAMENTAL NON-CLOSURE needs a conservation impossibility for the frozen architecture at any RF power, which B3 cannot show for P_abs > 0 (I_e,cap,UB grows with P_abs); it is not reachable by this method.

not_changed.registry: data/chemistry/icp/* are read, not changed. A table build changes the registry's tier-1 gap list, which the frozen M2 record regenerates byte for byte (crates/abep-assess/tests/m2_dbf1.rs committed_m2_record_is_the_a8_record_of_today reads the live registry through P-ICP-DBF1): changing it alters the regenerated frozen M2 record. Building tables therefore waits for the coordinator's M2-rerun decision (snapshot pin or M2 v2).
